# Priscilla and Aquila, Teammates (Romans 16:3)

## Emotional Focus
Husband and wife working as kind teammates.

## Key KJV
“Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus.” (Romans 16:3)

## Gentle Retelling
Priscilla and Aquila worked side by side making tents and helping the church. Paul called them his helpers in Christ.

## Coloring Prompt
Priscilla and Aquila sewing tents together with cheerful teamwork.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Kindness grows when we work together for Jesus.”
